the two new test comments ran 11 and 6 lines against a house median of 3-4 in browser.rs, and carried review narrative that an earlier commit on this same branch (bdb0702) had explicitly stripped from pin-tab test comments. Trimmed to 5 and 4 lines in fb37749, keeping only the invariant and the force-red recipe.

findings.claim: Candidate: the new rollback test may not guard the drift it names.
findings.evidence: First force-red attempt was wrong: patching the four attach call sites left the test green, because the test calls the wrapper directly. Corrected the recipe and the doc comment. Removing rollback_failed_launch from the wrapper's error arm makes it FAIL on the launch_hash assertion. The test's stated coverage limit (it drives the corrupt-binding failure, before the manager is touched, so it pins the error branch rather than the teardown of a live CDP connection) is written into the test comment rather than left implicit.

findings.claim: Candidate: the new restore-revive test may be vacuous.
findings.evidence: Replacing ensure_renderer_alive with a bare enable_domains in revive_and_enable_active makes the test FAIL by 20s timeout (Elapsed) on the mock CDP endpoint with a discarded bound tab. Green in 3.01s with the fix in place.
findings.layer: unit seam over a scripted CDP endpoint

findings.claim: The regression tests added in 5cabec7 re-introduced review narrative into test doc comments (which round found the gap, coverage caveats, internal mechanism restated from the code), on a branch where an earlier commit had already removed exactly that from the pin-tab tests.
findings.evidence: bdb0702 'docs(session): make pin-tab test comments agnostic (drop finding numbers)'. Comment lengths measured against browser.rs: median 3-4 lines per test, mine 11 and 6. Fixed in fb37749.

exemptions.claim: Removing the public enable_domains_pub is not a breaking change
exemptions.evidence: grep across cli/src returned only its definition, and the crate builds and tests clean without it; it is an inherent method on an internal type, not part of a published API.

exemptions.claim: A same-family reviewer is acceptable for this delta
exemptions.evidence: The delta is test-only plus a dead-code removal, and both tests were validated by force-red, an empirical check that does not depend on reviewer priors. WARNING recorded per the schema: author and reviewer share a family here, unlike the parent run which used codex.
